interpretation: These are locked operational safety windows for an unattended collector, not fitted betting thresholds. Predictions are prepared up to 20 minutes before T-4h so network-bound feature generation can finish; provider capture may begin no earlier than 120 seconds before T-4h and must finish by T-4h. Any miss remains a failure and is never backfilled.
required_review: Measure prediction and provider runtime distributions during the shadow period
Do not change these values during an evidence window without creating a new hashed runtime version
Never use operational timing changes to tune performance after outcomes are known
